svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/cad_readme.py from cad/metrics.json, the layout parameters, the CL-05 findings and the records. Placeholder
concept geometry: values are not design data, and flags are not requirements.

g.text: Terms: CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · DQ-nnn = decision
question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · SYS-nnn
= system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
